# Abhilash Kalathil Ramesh

> Executive Director, Kairali Ayurvedic Group · Angel Investor · AYUSH Policy Advocate

Abhilash Kalathil Ramesh is the eldest scion of the fourth generation of a Kerala-based Ayurveda-practising family (lineage since 1908). He serves as Executive Director of Kairali Ayurvedic Group, overseeing clinical operations (KTAHV, Palakkad), FMCG/pharmaceutical manufacturing (KAPPL, Kerala & Tamil Nadu), a global day-spa network (KAC), and the boutique wellness hospitality property Villa Raag in Goa. He is a founding board member of AYUSHEXCIL and an angel investor via Mumbai Angels Network.
